structural_reinforcement_supplement.install_length_rule: Per Drawing 20-178 Sheet 9 of 9 footing/post-reinforcement detail: reinforcement length is 48 in for Columbia/Imperial/Chesterfield/Breezewood models generally, except the aluminum reinforcement extends the full post length (footing depth + 7 in, per the alternate note) for Breezewood; general note also states an 18 in standard dimension is used except where noted. (Handwritten/scanned drawing text was only partially legible at max available resolution — the 48 in figure and the alloy/wall-thickness dimensions are clearly legible and are reported with confidence; the exact depth-dependent formula wording is reported as transcribed and should be treated as approximate.)

structural_reinforcement_supplement.dimensions: 4.500 in wide, 3.240 in tall, 0.750/0.562 in flange dims, 0.080 in / 0.036 in wall

structural_reinforcement_supplement.component: Gate / hinge / latch / end-post reinforcement (from field installation guidance, not the NOA drawings)
structural_reinforcement_supplement.method_a_rebar: Two pieces of 1/2 in rebar installed in each hinge, latch, and end post; rebar extends from the bottom of the post hole to 12 in from the top of the post; held in opposite corners of the post with rebar separator clips; post filled with concrete mix to cover rebar and hardware fasteners; tamped with a rubber mallet to eliminate air pockets; gate left on blocks 72 hours to allow concrete to cure.
structural_reinforcement_supplement.method_b_aluminum_stiffener: Aluminum gate-post stiffener slid inside the hinge/latch/end post with the open end facing the routed hole; secured with a screw driven through the vinyl into the aluminum stiffener at the base of the post; post then set into the ground and hole filled with concrete around the outside of the post.
structural_reinforcement_supplement.source: installvinylfencing.com/vinyl-fence-brands/how-to-install-bufftech-vinyl-fence (third-party install walkthrough, consistent with pass-1's generic 'BT-STIFFENER-ALUM' component and CertainTeed's own catalog language 'Aluminum post insert adds strength and simplifies installation... Heavy-duty internal aluminum frame for both gate kits and pre-assembled gates')
structural_reinforcement_supplement.confidence: Medium — third-party install guide, not the manufacturer's own document or the PE-sealed NOA drawings; presented as corroborating field practice rather than an authoritative spec.
